contracts.evidence_summary: Responses create uses POST /v1/responses with Bearer authentication and JSON model/input; response objects contain output and usage.
GPT-5.6 computer use is exposed through Responses with the computer tool and computer_call action output.
Embedding create uses POST /v1/embeddings with model/input and returns indexed vectors plus token usage.
Image generation uses POST /v1/images/generations with model/prompt and returns image data.
Image editing uses multipart POST /v1/images/edits with model, image and prompt; mask is used for inpainting.
Speech create uses POST /v1/audio/speech with model/input/voice and returns audio bytes.
Audio transcription uses multipart POST /v1/audio/transcriptions with file/model and returns transcript text with usage where supported.
Video create posts model/prompt to /v1/videos and returns a video task that is retrieved until completed.
Messages create requires x-api-key, anthropic-version, model/messages/max_tokens; canonical JSON Schema lowers to output_config.format, and Claude 5 uses adaptive rather than budget-based thinking.
Interactions create uses POST /v1beta/interactions with model/input and x-goog-api-key; function_result requires name, call_id and result and must match its preceding function_call.
Gemini transcription uses POST /v1beta/interactions with an audio input and generation_config.transcription_config.
Gemini image generation and editing use POST /v1beta/interactions with model/input and return image content blocks.
Gemini TTS uses POST /v1beta/interactions with audio response_format and generation_config.speech_config.
Lyria 3 music generation uses POST /v1beta/interactions with model/input and returns audio content.
EmbedContent puts the model in the v1beta path, accepts Content, and returns an embedding values array.
Gemini video generation uses models/{model}:predictLongRunning with instances/parameters and returns a pollable operation.
ESRGAN queue submit requires image_url at /fal-ai/esrgan and returns an image result after queue completion.
Imageutils rembg queue submit requires image_url at /fal-ai/imageutils/rembg and returns an image result after queue completion.
DeepFilterNet 3 queue submit requires audio_url at /fal-ai/deepfilternet3 and returns audio_file plus timings after completion.
Video Upscaler queue submit requires video_url at /fal-ai/video-upscaler, accepts scale, and returns a video result after completion.
MiniMax Anthropic-compatible text uses /anthropic/v1/messages and the Messages request/response shape.
Synchronous T2A uses POST /v1/t2a_v2 with Bearer auth, model/text, and returns hex audio with base_resp.
MiniMax image generation uses POST /v1/image_generation with model/prompt and returns data.image_urls.
MiniMax text/image-to-video submits POST /v1/video_generation and returns task_id.
MiniMax music generation uses POST /v1/music_generation and returns audio/status with base_resp.
OpenRouter chat completions uses POST /api/v1/chat/completions with Bearer auth; assistant reasoning_details must be passed back unmodified for multi-turn reasoning and tool use.
OpenRouter embeddings uses POST /api/v1/embeddings with Bearer authentication and OpenAI-compatible model/input and embedding results.
OpenRouter rerank uses POST /api/v1/rerank and returns ordered index/relevance_score results.
Kimi Chat Completions uses POST /v1/chat/completions with Bearer authentication, JSON model/messages, OpenAI-style choices and data-only SSE terminated by [DONE].
GLM Chat Completion uses POST /api/paas/v4/chat/completions with Bearer authentication and JSON model/messages; streaming is standard SSE terminated by [DONE].
DeepSeek Responses uses POST /responses with Bearer authentication and stateless JSON model/input; semantic SSE ends with a response terminal event and no [DONE] marker.
Volcano Ark Responses uses POST /api/v3/responses with Bearer authentication and JSON model/input, accepts the object-valued thinking control, and returns an OpenAI-style response object.
Qwen workspace-compatible Responses uses POST /compatible-mode/v1/responses with Bearer authentication and JSON model/input, returning OpenAI-style response output.
SN public source at f765081 exposes POST /api/v1/ai/responses with Bearer authentication and forwards the Responses JSON/SSE wire to LiteLLM /v1/responses.

openai.evidence_summary: OpenAI documents HTTP authentication, permission, request, not-found, rate-limit and server error categories with an error envelope.

claude.evidence_summary: Anthropic documents status-specific error.type values and the top-level error/request_id envelope.

google-gemini.evidence_summary: Gemini documents Google RPC error code/message/status envelopes for request, auth, quota and service failures.

fal.evidence_summary: fal separates typed model-validation detail arrays from flat infrastructure detail/error_type responses and exposes retry/error headers.

minimax.evidence_summary: MiniMax documents Provider application error codes carried by base_resp, including timeout, rate limit, auth, balance, safety and internal errors.

openrouter.evidence_summary: OpenRouter documents numeric HTTP-aligned error codes in its error envelope and upstream Provider failures.

kimi.evidence_summary: Kimi documents error.type/message envelopes for invalid requests, authentication, permissions, missing resources, rate limits, quota and server failures.

glm.evidence_summary: GLM documents an error code/message envelope with HTTP status plus business codes including 1000 authentication, 1210 invalid parameter, 1302 rate limit and 1305 overload.

deepseek.evidence_summary: DeepSeek documents 400 invalid format, 401 authentication, 402 balance, 422 invalid parameters, 429 rate limit and 5xx service failures.

doubao.evidence_summary: Volcano Ark documents OpenAI-compatible error envelopes and HTTP-aligned request, authentication, throttling and server failure codes.

qwen.evidence_summary: Alibaba Model Studio documents OpenAI-compatible error codes including invalid_request_error, invalid_api_key, access_denied, Throttling and InternalError.

sn-ai-provider.evidence_summary: SN source at f765081 defines HTTP errors as code/message and the 429 insufficient-balance special case as an OpenAI-shaped nested error.
